_comment: The event deck. One is drawn for a club every 5-10 matches it reports, and one league-wide
when the commissioner closes a round. An event is a PROBLEM THE MANAGER ANSWERS — it blocks
further match reports until it is dealt with — so every template here must earn that
interruption. There is no delegation and no commissioner override: the manager answers it.
Add your own freely. Nothing is referenced by name in code except `kind`, which must be one
of the vocabulary in lib/services/effects.ts, and `target`/`type` macros beginning with @.
RULES THE VALIDATION TEST ENFORCES (lib/services/events.test.ts):
- Every template has at least one option with no `cost` and no `requires`, and that is the
one marked `default: true`. Reporting is blocked while an event is pending and nothing
else can answer it, so this rule is the whole of what stops a club being stranded.
- Exactly one `default: true`, and it may not `repeat` — it has to exist for every club.
- Two options is the shape that works: one resource traded against another. Three is
allowed where each is a genuinely different answer; more than three only with
`tierLadder: true`, where they are the same decision at escalating stakes.
- Every lasting effect carries `label` and `liftedMessage`, and a duration in `matches`,
`events` or `rounds`. A restriction that expires silently is one nobody noticed.
- Every percentage-of-cash cost carries a `min`, and a flat `amount` is a real number.
Without a floor a broke club pays 12% of nothing. ESCROW is the one exemption: a stake
comes back, so a floor there just makes the poor commit more — gate it with `minCash`.
- Effect-specific rules: PLEDGE needs `wins`/`outOf` and a reward or penalty; ESCROW needs
`returnPct` and `rounds`; SWAP_OFFER a `bonusPct`; RELEASE_FOR_TWO a `pct` and `count`;
INJURY_ROLL at least two `faces`; GIFT_POKEMON its `tiers`.
ANNOUNCEMENTS: `announcement: true` with top-level `effects` and no `options` is news rather
than a question. It resolves itself, so it never blocks anybody. Used for the league-wide
shocks everyone is subject to and nobody can buy their way out of.
VIRTUES: `virtue` plus `virtueChance` (a percentage) inverts the event. Same draw, same
eligibility, same subject — the Pokémon that was going to sulk decides to carry the team.
A virtue resolves itself, is shown in gold, and still puts its template on cooldown.
LETTING THE CLUB CHOOSE WHO: an option with `repeat: "@starters"` becomes one option per
Pokémon — 'Let Garchomp go', 'Let Ferrothorn go' — each fully resolved, spread across the
squad by value. A decision is still just a key. `repeatMax` caps how many branches.
RIPPLES: `spreadTo: "starters"` with `spreadCount`/`spreadPct` puts a milder copy on other
Pokémon, picked at draw time from the squad as it stands. `spreadOnly: true` drops the copy
that would have landed on the subject — for an event whose subject is leaving the club.
MONEY THAT SCALES: a win is worth P1,000 in the beginner tier and P100,000 in Champion, so
`amountWins` / `rewardWins` / `penaltyWins` price a sum in the club's own win rewards, and
`pct` + `min` prices it against the balance. Flat `amount` only where neither makes sense —
a bill that does not get bigger because the club got richer.
PLACEHOLDERS: {team} {pokemon} {other} {cost} {type}
{incoming} — who arrives in a swap or a release-for-two
{incomingTier} — the tier they come from, when the offer names only a tier
{ladder} — a published roll table, as odds in words
{amount} {reward} {penalty} {back} — sums the effect settled at draw time
TARGET MACROS: @mostValuableStarter @cheapestStarter @randomStarter @captain @trigger
@mostUsed @secondMostUsed — the two the club leans on hardest
TYPE MACROS:   @mostOwnedType @randomOwnedType

events.title: Forgotten man
events.description: {pokemon} has not seen the field in a long time. It has noticed, and so has everyone else in the dressing room.

virtue.title: Training on its own
virtue.description: Nobody told {pokemon} it had been forgotten. It has spent the weeks it was not picked getting better than the Pokémon who were, and this week it showed everybody.

options.label: Put it straight back in
options.detail: It takes the field in each of your next 4 matches, whatever else happens. Bring it and leave it on the bench and the report is refused.

effects.label: {pokemon} must take the field
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} has had its run in the side. You can rotate again.

options.label: Sell it while somebody still wants it
options.detail: It goes back on the market today and {amount} lands in the account. You are a Pokémon lighter, and nobody in the dressing room blames you for it.

effects.label: Sold {pokemon}, who had asked to play

options.label: Tell it to wait its turn
options.detail: It stays, it sulks, and the rest of the squad takes its side. Every Pokémon you own loses 25% of its value.

events.title: Running on empty
events.description: {pokemon} has started all ten of your last ten. The results are holding up; the Pokémon isn't.

virtue.title: Some of them are built for it
virtue.description: Ten from ten, and {pokemon} came in on its day off. The rest of {team} has noticed who sets the standard.

effects.label: {pokemon} setting the standard — win rewards up 40%
effects.liftedMessage: The lift {pokemon} gave everybody has levelled off. Rewards are back to normal.

options.label: Rest it properly
options.detail: Out for 3 matches. It comes back sharp.

effects.label: {pokemon} — rested
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} is rested and available again.

options.label: Push on regardless
options.detail: It plays every match, on empty. For 5 matches it runs with no EVs invested, and it is too flat to move first: no priority moves at all, including the ones a field condition hands it.

effects.label: {pokemon} — running on empty, no EVs invested
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} has its legs back. Train it properly again.

effects.label: {pokemon} — no priority moves, including field-granted ones like Grassy Glide
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} is sharp again. It can move first when it needs to.

events.title: Too many new faces
events.description: {team} has been busy in the market, and it shows. Nobody quite knows where anybody else is going to be.

options.label: Book a training camp
options.detail: {cost} for a fortnight of drills, and they sort themselves out. No more business until the round turns: the squad is unsettled because you kept changing it.

effects.label: At a training camp — no signings, sales or trades
effects.liftedMessage: The camp is over. {team} can deal again.

options.label: Let them work it out on the field
options.detail: No switching for 3 matches while they learn each other. It means no switching by hand: a switch a move causes — Volt Switch, U-turn, Parting Shot, Roar — is still fine.

effects.label: No manual switching, the squad is still settling — move-forced switches (Volt Switch, Parting Shot, Roar) are fine
effects.liftedMessage: The squad has settled. Switch freely again.

events.title: Nothing to lose
events.description: Bottom of the table, and a season that has not gone your way. A backer nobody else would take a call from wants to bankroll {team}, and does not much care what you do with it.

options.label: Take the money
options.detail: ₽100,000 into the account tonight. No conditions, no favours owed, and you decide what it buys.

options.label: Let them buy you a player
options.detail: They will not say who. Somebody out of the top two tiers signs for nothing — worth more than the money if it falls your way, and nobody is promising it will.

events.title: Transfer request
events.description: {pokemon} has asked to leave. Three defeats in a row, and the mood around {team} has turned.

virtue.title: It has decided to carry this team
virtue.description: {pokemon} was asked how it felt about the run of results. It answered by dragging {team} through training like a side that has forgotten how to lose.

effects.label: {pokemon} is inspired — value moves amplified
effects.liftedMessage: The purple patch is over. {pokemon} moves in value normally again.

options.label: Pay a loyalty bonus
options.detail: {cost}. It stays, and the show of faith is worth something — value up 5%.

options.label: Send your captain to talk it down
options.detail: Settles it outright — a word from somebody the squad actually listens to. Your captain can't step into another dispute until five more events have come and gone.

effects.label: Your captain has spent its credit in the dressing room
effects.liftedMessage: Your captain has the dressing room's ear again.

options.label: Refuse it
options.detail: It stays, and it sulks. Five matches with no EVs and no Mega Evolution.

effects.label: {pokemon} — run it with no EVs invested
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} has come round. Train it properly again.
effects.spreadLabel: {pokemon} — unsettled by it, run with no EVs invested
effects.spreadLiftedMessage: {pokemon} has stopped worrying about it. Train it properly again.

effects.label: {pokemon} — no Mega Evolution
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} is ready to Mega Evolve again.

events.title: Contract standoff
events.description: {pokemon} knows exactly what it is worth to {team}, and has come to discuss the matter.

virtue.title: It signed on the spot
virtue.description: {pokemon}'s people came in with a number, and {pokemon} signed the first thing put in front of it instead. It says it likes it here.

options.label: Meet the demand
options.detail: {cost}, and the matter is closed.

options.label: Promise it the shirt instead
options.detail: No money changes hands. For your next 4 matches {pokemon} opens every one of them — never benched, and everyone on the other side knows exactly what they are looking at.

effects.label: {pokemon} must take the field — you promised
effects.liftedMessage: You kept your word to {pokemon}. Rotate as you like.

effects.label: {pokemon} led the match — you promised it the shirt
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} no longer has to open. Lead with whoever suits.

options.label: Let it explore its options
options.detail: Nothing changes here. {pokemon} goes on the board at {amount} — what it is worth plus the 10% it came asking for — and for five days any club in the league may simply take it at that price. You cannot change your mind in the meantime. If nobody comes, it is still yours and nothing has been lost but the asking.

events.title: Lost confidence
events.description: {pokemon} has stopped trying things. It is going through the motions, and the run of results is the reason.

virtue.title: Something clicked
virtue.description: Whatever was said to {pokemon} this week worked. It has been the best thing about {team} in training.

effects.label: {pokemon} is flying — value moves amplified
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} is back to its usual self.

options.label: Take it out of the firing line
options.detail: Out for 2 matches while it gets its head straight.

effects.label: {pokemon} — out of the side
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} is ready to play again.

options.label: Strip it back to basics
options.detail: It keeps playing, but attacks only — no status moves for 4 matches.

effects.label: {pokemon} — no status moves
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} has its confidence back. Use its full moveset again.

events.title: The pitch is being relaid
events.description: {team}'s ground is a building site. The field itself is usable; nothing that changes the conditions on it is.

options.label: Accelerate the repairs
options.detail: {cost} to put a second crew on it and work through the nights. The ground is ready for your next match, and nothing changes about how you play.

options.label: Play through it
options.detail: No weather and no terrain for 5 matches.

effects.label: No weather — the pitch is being relaid
effects.liftedMessage: The new pitch is down. Set weather freely again.

effects.label: No terrain — the pitch is being relaid
effects.liftedMessage: The new pitch is down. Set terrain freely again.

events.title: Power cut at the training centre
events.description: The Key Stone rigs at {team}'s facility have been dark for three days and the contractor is not returning calls.

virtue.title: A week without the machines
virtue.description: Nothing worked for six days, so they trained the way people did before any of it existed. {team} has not looked this sharp all season.

effects.label: Back to basics — values moving 30% faster
effects.liftedMessage: The novelty has worn off. Values move normally again.

options.label: Hire a generator
options.detail: {cost}, and everything works as normal.

options.label: Manage without
options.detail: No Mega Evolution at all for 4 matches.

effects.label: No Mega Evolution — the Key Stone rigs are down
effects.liftedMessage: The power is back. Mega Evolution is available again.

events.title: The coach has a philosophy
events.description: {team}'s new battle coach has strong views about type synergy, and has been explaining them at length.

options.label: Humour them
options.detail: Every attack has to be same-type, for 3 matches. Status moves are not the coach's concern — Protect, Tailwind, a burn, whatever you like, of any type at all.

effects.label: Attacking moves must be same-type — coach's orders. Status moves, any type
effects.liftedMessage: The coach has moved on to a new theory. Attack however you like.

options.label: Pay them off
options.detail: {cost}, and they take their philosophy elsewhere.

events.title: They have your patterns
events.description: Somebody has been charting how {team} opens a match. Opponents are arriving knowing who is coming out first and what tends to follow.

options.label: Move training ground
options.detail: {cost}, and the leak stops.

options.label: Lead with your best and dare them
options.detail: Stop trying to outguess a book they have already written. {pokemon} opens each of your next 3 matches — they will know it is coming, and they will have to beat it anyway.

effects.label: {pokemon} led the match — they know it is coming
effects.liftedMessage: The scout has moved on. Open with whoever suits.

events.title: Item recall
events.description: A batch of held items has been recalled league-wide, and {team}'s order was in it.

options.label: Replace them out of pocket
options.detail: {cost}, and nobody notices. A crate of held items costs what it costs, whatever the club is worth.

options.label: Take the sponsor's crate
options.detail: They have pallets of {item} and nothing else. {pokemon} holds one for 4 matches, whether it suits it or not.

effects.label: {pokemon} — must hold {item}
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} can hold what suits it again.

options.label: Go without
options.detail: {pokemon} holds nothing for 4 matches.

effects.label: {pokemon} — no held item
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon}'s replacement item has arrived.

events.title: Knock in training
events.description: {pokemon} came out of a training battle holding a leg. The physio wants a decision today.

virtue.title: Nothing in it
virtue.description: {pokemon} walked into the scan laughing and walked out the same way. Whatever it was, it has gone, and it has spent the week training like something with a point to prove.

options.label: Pay for proper treatment
options.detail: {cost}. Out for 1 match and no lasting effect.

effects.label: {pokemon} — injured
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} has been passed fit.

options.label: Rest it and let it heal
options.detail: Out for 3 matches. No cost, no complications.

effects.label: {pokemon} — injured
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} has recovered and is available again.

options.label: Rush it back
options.detail: It trains tomorrow and the scan is after that. One roll of six, and these are the odds: {ladder}.

effects.label: {pokemon} — rushed back, and it has gone
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} is fit at last. It will not be hurried again.

events.title: It came to blows
events.description: {pokemon} and {other} have been carrying something between them for weeks, and at training it stopped being an argument. They are the two this club leans on hardest and neither will give way, so one of them is not playing until it settles. You decide which.

virtue.title: They sorted it themselves
virtue.description: Whatever {pokemon} and {other} said to each other, they said it out of earshot and came back training like a pair who had remembered they are on the same side. {team} has not looked this settled all season.

effects.label: The dressing room has sorted itself out — win rewards up 20%
effects.liftedMessage: Back to normal, and no harm done. Rewards are as they were.

options.label: Stand {pokemon} down
options.detail: {pokemon} sits out the next 2 matches. It is the one you use most, and it will know exactly what the decision meant.

effects.label: {pokemon} — stood down after the row
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} is back in the side, and it is over.

options.label: Stand {other} down
options.detail: {other} sits out the next 2 matches instead. The one you lean on hardest stays in the side, and everybody in that dressing room draws their own conclusion about why.

effects.label: {pokemon} — stood down after the row
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} is back in the side, and it is over.

events.title: Conduct charge
events.description: The league has charged {pokemon} over an incident at the end of a recent match, and the panel is minded to make an example of somebody. One of the people on that panel has let it be known that the case need not be heard at all.

virtue.title: Charge dismissed
virtue.description: The panel watched the footage twice and threw it out inside ten minutes. {pokemon} has come back from it with a reputation for being hard done by, which is worth something.

options.label: Make the case go away
options.detail: {cost}, handed over without a receipt. The charge is dropped before it is ever heard, and nobody at {team} says another word about it.

options.label: Take it on the club
options.detail: Argue that it was nobody's fault but the club's. The panel agrees, and sanctions {team} instead: five names on the sheet rather than six for 5 matches. You still take four into every match — you simply have no cover for any of them.

effects.label: Under sanction — five registered, not six
effects.liftedMessage: The sanction is served. Register a full six again.

events.title: Regulation shift
events.description: The season's regulation update has landed, and it has landed on {type}-types. Every club in the league is bound by it for the next three matches, whatever that costs them — and it will cost some of them a great deal more than others.

effects.label: No {type}-types — regulation shift
effects.liftedMessage: The {type}-type restriction has been lifted. They are legal again.

events.title: The league wants a word about your accounts
events.description: {team}'s filings have been selected for review. The number at the bottom is not in dispute; only when it is paid.

virtue.title: They owed you
virtue.description: The auditors went back four years and came out the other side apologising. {team} has been underpaid for most of them.

effects.label: Audit settled in your favour

options.label: Settle it now
options.detail: {cost}, paid today, and it is finished.

options.label: Take the payment plan
options.detail: Nothing today. Over your next 3 matches an instalment of {amount} falls due — but only on the ones you lose. Win all three and the whole thing has cost you nothing.

effects.label: Payment plan — {amount} on every match you lose
effects.liftedMessage: The plan has run its course. Your accounts are clear.

events.title: Your sponsor is pulling out
events.description: {team}'s shirt sponsor has invoked a clause nobody read closely enough at the time.

virtue.title: Somebody better was waiting
virtue.description: The sponsor walked and a rival of theirs was on the phone inside the hour, with a better offer and a grudge to settle.

effects.label: New sponsor — win rewards up 30%
effects.liftedMessage: The signing bonus is spent. {team}'s rewards are back to normal.

options.label: Buy out the clause
options.detail: {cost}, and the deal runs to term.

options.label: Sign with their rival instead
options.detail: Full money, but they want their mascot on the field — {pokemon} takes the field in each of your next 6 matches.

effects.label: {pokemon} must take the field — the new sponsor insists
effects.liftedMessage: The sponsor's campaign is over. {pokemon} can be rotated again.

options.label: Play unsponsored
options.detail: Nothing to pay, but match winnings drop to 60% for 6 matches.

effects.label: Unsponsored — match winnings at 60%
effects.liftedMessage: {team} has found a new sponsor. Winnings are back to full.

events.title: Every lineup in the league has leaked
events.description: A database of registered lineups has found its way onto the forums, and it is far too late to take it down again. For the next four matches every club in this league opens with its captain, because every club in this league already knows who that is.

effects.label: {pokemon} must lead — every lineup in the league is public
effects.liftedMessage: The leak has gone stale. Open with whoever you like again.

events.title: A prospect worth backing
events.description: {team}'s scouts have seen enough of {pokemon} to think it is being wasted, and the development programme has a place open. It costs nothing but the Pokémon: five matches away from the side, and it comes back a better prospect than it went in.

options.label: Send it to the programme
options.detail: No fee. {pokemon} is unavailable for your next five matches, and gains 30% in value.

effects.label: {pokemon} — away with the development programme
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} is back from the development programme and available again.

options.label: Keep it in the side
options.detail: The place goes to somebody else. {pokemon} stays available, and stays as it is.

events.title: A straight swap
events.description: A rival club has come in for {pokemon}. They will not pay cash for it, but they will part with somebody of the same standing or a rung above — and the one arriving comes in worth 15% more than the one leaving. The dressing room is watching to see what {team} does with it.

options.label: Do the deal
options.detail: {pokemon} goes, {incoming} ({incomingTier} tier) arrives, valued 15% above what {pokemon} is worth to you. The rest of the squad takes it badly and plays the next 2 matches with nothing invested — the new arrival aside.

effects.label: Swapped {pokemon} for {incoming}
{pokemon} — run with no EVs
effects.liftedMessage: {pokemon} has settled. Its EV spread is its own again.
effects.spreadLabel: {pokemon} — unsettled by the sale, run with no EVs
effects.spreadLiftedMessage: {pokemon} has moved on from the sale. Its EV spread is its own again.

options.label: Turn them down
options.detail: {pokemon} is not for sale, and that is the end of it. Nothing else changes.

events.title: Two for one
events.description: The recruitment staff at {team} have a standing proposal. Give up one of the senior squad and they will bring in two of the same standing with what it frees up — each worth half of what the one leaving was worth to you. Which two is the market's business, not yours: you will find out when the paperwork clears.

options.label: Let {pokemon} go
options.detail: {pokemon} leaves for nothing. Two unsigned {incomingTier} tier Pokémon arrive in its place, each worth half of what {pokemon} was worth to you. You do not get to pick them.

effects.label: Released {pokemon} for two from the {incomingTier} tier

options.label: Keep the squad together
options.detail: The recruitment staff are overruled, and take it personally. No signings, sales or trades for the rest of this round and all of the next.

effects.label: Recruitment frozen — no signings, sales or trades
effects.liftedMessage: The recruitment staff have got over it. {team} can deal again.

events.title: Name your target
events.description: The sponsor at {team} wants a headline with its name on it, and has left the size of the headline entirely to you. Set a target for the next five matches. Hit it and they pay. Miss it and they take the difference out of the fee.

options.label: Two wins in five
options.detail: {reward} if you manage it. {penalty} if you don't.

effects.label: Sponsor target — 2 wins from 5
effects.liftedMessage: The sponsor's books are closed on this one.

options.label: Four wins in five
options.detail: {reward} if you manage it. {penalty} if you don't.

effects.label: Sponsor target — 4 wins from 5
effects.liftedMessage: The sponsor's books are closed on this one.

options.label: All five
options.detail: {reward} if you manage it. {penalty} if you don't. They think you won't.

effects.label: Sponsor target — 5 wins from 5
effects.liftedMessage: The sponsor's books are closed on this one.

options.label: Turn the sponsor down
options.detail: No target and no fee. They put their name on somebody else's shirt, and {team} carries on exactly as it was.

events.title: Fee or bonus
events.description: The sponsor has come back with a simpler question. Would {team} rather be paid for turning up, or for winning?

options.label: Take the money up front
options.detail: {amount} in the bank today. Win rewards halve for the next six matches.

effects.label: Appearance fee
Appearance fee taken — win rewards halved
effects.liftedMessage: The appearance deal has run its course. {team}'s win rewards are whole again.

options.label: Back yourselves
options.detail: Nothing today. Win rewards double for the next six matches.

effects.label: Win bonus — win rewards doubled
effects.liftedMessage: The win bonus is over. {team}'s rewards are back to normal.

events.title: The league bond
events.description: The league is raising money against next season's fixtures, and every club has been sent the same terms on the same morning. A fifth of what you hold, locked away until the round after next, and it comes back a fifth larger than it went in.

options.label: Buy in
options.detail: {amount} locked away now. {back} back when the round after next closes — and nothing to sign with in the meantime.

effects.label: League bond — {amount} locked away
effects.liftedMessage: The league bond has matured. {team} has been paid out.

options.label: Stay out of it
options.detail: The league raises it without {team}. Your money stays where it is and nothing else changes.

events.title: They have read the book on you
events.description: Half the league has mapped out how {team} attacks. Everybody knows which attack is coming, and they have started switching into it on purpose.

options.label: Rebuild the sets
options.detail: {cost} on analysts and practice time. The problem goes away before it costs you anything.

options.label: Beat them off-script
options.detail: Three matches without a single same-type attack — coverage moves only. Status moves are not attacks and do not count: Protect, Tailwind, Fake Out, a burn, whatever you like, of any type at all, same-type included.

effects.label: No same-type attacking moves. Status moves are exempt, of any type
effects.liftedMessage: {team} has fresh sets ready. Same-type attacks are back on the menu.

events.title: Nobody's flight landed
events.description: Half of {team} is still in a departure lounge two hundred miles away, and the ladder does not wait for anybody. Whoever travels has to be decided tonight, and the only seats left out of there are being sold at the price of seats bought tonight.

virtue.title: The best week they had
virtue.description: Nine hours on a coach with nothing to do but talk to each other. Whatever happened on that road, {team} came back a side rather than a squad.

effects.label: Something clicked on the road — win rewards up 25%
effects.liftedMessage: It has worn off, the way these things do. Rewards are back to normal.

options.label: Buy the last seats out of there
options.detail: {cost} for six fares bought on the night. Everybody lands, everybody is registered, and nothing about the next three matches changes.

options.label: Go with whoever made it
options.detail: Four of your six travel, for the next three matches — and four is exactly what you take into a match. Whoever gets on the plane tonight is your side, decided before you have seen a single thing the opposition brings.

effects.label: Travelling light — four registered, and no choice left at team preview
effects.liftedMessage: The rest of {team} has finally landed. Register a full six again.

events.title: A word about how you play
events.description: Three opponents have written to the league about {team} inside a month. Nobody has used the word cheating, and nobody has quite avoided it either.

options.label: Carry on, and take the fine
options.detail: {cost}, and you play how you like. The officials will be watching {pokemon} lead for the next three.

effects.label: {pokemon} must lead — the officials are watching
effects.liftedMessage: The league has moved on to somebody else. Lead with whoever you like.

options.label: Play it their way
options.detail: Four matches without a protection move of any kind. You will have to win them on the front foot.

effects.label: No protection moves
effects.liftedMessage: The complaint has been filed and forgotten. Protect away.
